title: Stock Trading Strategy with Overhead
description:
You are given an array of daily stock prices and a fixed transaction fee. You may complete as many transactions as you like (buy one and sell one share of the stock), but each transaction (a buy and a sell) incurs the specified fee. You must sell your current share before buying again. Find the maximum total profit you can accumulate.

Example 1
Input: prices = [1,3,2,8,4,9], fee = 2
Output: 8

Example 2
Input: prices = [1,3,7,5,10,3], fee = 3
Output: 6
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n representing the number of days.
The second line contains n space-separated integers representing stock prices.
The third line contains an integer fee.
output_format: Print the maximum total profit from all transactions.
